Opportunity

Maersk is a global leader in integrated logistics and have been industry pioneers for over a century. Through innovation and transformation we are redefining the boundaries of possibility, continuously setting new standards for efficiency, sustainability, and excellence.

At Maersk, we believe in the power of diversity, collaboration, and continuous learning and we work hard to ensure that the people in our organisation reflect and understand the customers we exist to serve.

With over 100,000 employees across 130 countries, we work together to shape the future of global trade and logistics.

Join us as we harness cutting-edge technologies and unlock opportunities on a global scale. Together, let's sail towards a brighter, more sustainable future with Maersk.

Key responsibilities

• You will have an end-to-end responsibility, accountability and handling entire demand to delivery process for allocated set of Maersk Line vessels and ensure the 4R Principle – Right price, Right Place, Right Time and Right Quantity.

• Running the RFQ process with non-contracted suppliers for optimal deliveries.

• Follow Procure to Pay process (PTP) for timely payments to all vendors and handle invoices with discrepancies.

• To be familiar with IT platform / system operation with good knowledge to gain maximum output of offered tools and ensure Process compliance.

• Share inputs towards assigned team Initiatives around Category Strategies. Should be keen on learning and acquiring right skill set.

• Support with implementing automation as part of the Digital Agenda.

• Support Senior colleagues with Supplier Performance Management tasks.

• Share inputs with Master data teams to optimize back-end data quality.

• Assist Senior colleagues with the transactional support around Team initiatives & drives.

• Always follow the Maersk’s carbon neutral initiative to minimize the carbon emission in our supply chains.

We are looking for

This position is well-suited to an individual with strong interpersonal skills, capable of developing and influencing internal and external relationships. The ideal candidate will come with:

• 5+ years of experience in procurement domain

• A proven track record of planning and supply chain in an international matrix organization.

• Has a strong mindset with a natural focus on achieving the most cost-effective solutions for the business.

• Strong time management and ability to prioritize under ambitious timelines

• Experience in the marine industry will be considered an advantage

• An educational background in relevant fields of Engineering and/or a Masters in Supply Chain or Operations Management

Furthermore you:

• Are a self-driven team player, who understands the importance of stakeholder management, can build rapport at all levels even in challenging situations, and can encourage and influence others without authority

• Have an entrepreneurial mindset and strong analytical skills.

• Can take ownership, work independently in a structured manner, and achieve concrete results.

• You can handle risks and uncertainties and are flexible in adapting when priorities change. You feel comfortable challenging the status quo and are motivated to lead change.

• Are an excellent communicator in English both in writing and in speaking.

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.

We are happy to support your need for any adjustments during the application and hiring process. If you need special assistance or an accommodation to use our website, apply for a position, or to perform a job, please contact us by emailing  accommodationrequests@maersk.com.

Department: Operations (Engineering Services & Customer Support)

Location: Copenhagen

**Description

**At Factbird, we help manufacturers see what’s really happening on their lines, so they can make better, faster decisions. Our plug-and-play hardware and cloud platform turn live production data into clear insights, and we’re scaling fast across sites, teams, and countries.

We’re looking for a hands-on Senior IoT Solutions Engineer to join Engineering Services, the team that takes on the technical problems that fall outside what our product and Support handle today. You’ll look at a PLC, a sensor, or a 20-year-old CNC and work out how to get its data into Factbird. Sales and Support turn to you when the answer is “it depends,” and you turn that into a clear yes, no, or “here’s how.” Then you write it down so the next person doesn’t need to ask.

****About the role

**Engineering Services solves the hardest technical problems, documents them, and shares the knowledge, so Factbird gets smarter and the same problem doesn’t come back. You’ll answer feasibility questions before deals close, design and build custom solutions, and fix the cross-domain problems no other team can place.

**

The team mission we are on: Engineering Services is a small team of experts finding solutions to a wide variety of challenges. In pre-sales we are supporting our AE's and Solution Consultants with feasibility testing the most complex customer setups or requirements. Often directly with the customers and their technical teams. In post-sales we collaborate with Cloud, FW and HW teams, and build and support a range of custom solutions. Our core mission is to increase documentation, standardization and empowering our colleagues in both pre- and post-sales roles to server the customers in the most technical cases.

**What You'll Do

**

• Answer feasibility questions from Sales: can we connect this machine, PLC, or sensor, and how

• Design and build custom solutions: logic boxes, signal converters, IO-Link modules, EDGE flows, and Factbird® powered by OMRON NX1 programs that fill gaps the cloud platform can’t handle yet.

• Design the integration: map the customer’s OT/IT environment and plan the data sources, tag structures, transformations, and security.

• Root cause troubleshooting in live production. Smaller share of time, highest stakes

• Document everything you build and fix: Solution Records, runbooks, and wiring guides for customers and internal teams, clear enough that someone else can pick it up. Version and back up every configuration.

• Bench-test hardware before it ships, test the full data flow end to end (including failure recovery and restarts), and hand hardware to Logistics with a clear packing list.

• Integrate customer systems through Kepware, Ignition, OPC UA, MQTT, EtherNet/IP, Modbus, and Node-RED.

• Share what you know: help Support, Solution Consultants, and Hardware handle more on their own.

• Streamline as you go: spot repeat work and clunky processes, and fix them or flag them. Build templates and scripts that make the next delivery faster.

• Turn repeat workarounds into product input with a business case, so the workaround can disappear.

• Join customer and prospect calls as the technical voice alongside Solution Consultants and Account Managers.

**About you

**You’re an experienced industrial automation engineer, as happy with a screwdriver as with a terminal. You know how factories work, and you’re comfortable saying “not directly, but here’s the route.”

You document like the next person depends on it, because they do. You can’t leave a clunky process alone: you always have an eye on how to make things simpler and more repeatable.

You’re flexible and self-directed: you take a high level of accountability and ownership. You can prioritize and deliver without daily supervision, and you troubleshoot systematically when things get ambiguous. The work changes week to week, and the team’s shape will keep evolving as Factbird grows. You’re happy to do what’s needed today while helping move things in a more scalable direction.

You love being the expert, but you equally love teaching others and making the teams around you smarter. And most of all, you care about making the answer simple for whoever asked.

Requirements:

• A bachelor's degree in automation, electrical engineering, mechatronics, or similar, or equivalent hands-on experience.

• At least 5 years in industrial automation or controls engineering, including hands-on work on the shop floor (7+ years preferred).

• Hands-on PLC experience with at least one major vendor, e.g. Siemens, Omron, or Rockwell/Allen-Bradley.

• Solid understanding of industrial protocols, e.g. OPC UA, Modbus, EtherNet/IP, MQTT.

• Working knowledge of sensors and signals, like digital, analog (4–20 mA, 0–10 V), IO-Link, PNP/NPN, and energy metering.

• Root cause analysis across hardware, networks, and software in live production environments.

• Field experience commissioning or troubleshooting equipment in live plants.

• Comfortable troubleshooting site networks, e.g. IP setup, routers, SIMs, and firewalls.

• A clear communicator in English who can explain technical trade-offs to non-engineers.

• A strong documentation habit: when you build it, you write it down.

**Why Factbird?

**People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams — and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it.

Here's what you can look forward to:

• Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn’t one-size-fits-all, and neither is work.

• Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact.

• Internet reimbursement: Stay connected and productive, wherever you choose to work from.

• Thoughtful, human onboarding: We’ll support you step by step, giving you the context, tools, and guidance you need to feel confident from day one.

• A career path that grows with you: Through bi-yearly Individual Development Plan conversations, we’ll work together to shape a career journey that fits your ambitions.

• Company-wide kickoffs & team days: We regularly come together across teams and regions to connect, celebrate, and align on what’s next.

• A global, inclusive culture: We’re proud of our diverse backgrounds and perspectives — and we actively celebrate them in how we work and collaborate.

**We’d love to hear from you

**If this role feels like a match, we’d be excited to hear from you and explore how you could help shape the future of data collection and production monitoring at Factbird.

And if someone in your network comes to mind who might be a great fit — feel free to share this opportunity with them.

Have questions? You can always reach out to Khristel, our Global Talent Acquisition & People Operations Lead at **khma@factbird.com

**_At Factbird, we believe that great work starts with people feeling respected, valued, and included. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

__All employment decisions at Factbird are made based on business needs, role requirements, and individual qualifications, without discrimination based on gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, marital or family status, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected under applicable European and local employment laws.

_We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences make our teams stronger and our work better. We warmly encourage all qualified candidates to apply and to bring their whole selves to Factbird.

**Job Title: Global Service Specialist – DO/EIMCO, Flotation, PCV, DSG

****Position Summary

**FLS is seeking a highly skilled and professional Global Service Specialist to support the erection, installation, pre‑commissioning, commissioning, and operational startup of commercial and industrial separation equipment. This role focuses primarily on mechanical work and Installation & Commissioning (I&C) activities for thickeners and flotation cells, with additional responsibility for equipment such as clarifiers, cyclones, pumps, reactors, and agitated tanks.

The Global Service Specialist serves as FLS’s primary onsite representative and is responsible for delivering high‑quality technical service, maintaining strong customer relationships, and ensuring safe and efficient project execution. This position requires extensive international travel and the ability to work independently under demanding conditions.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Execute onsite erection, installation, alignment, and commissioning of mechanical systems and I&C activities for thickeners, flotation cells, and related separation equipment.

• Lead pre‑commissioning and commissioning processes to ensure equipment meets design, safety, and performance requirements.

• Support operational startup, troubleshooting, and optimization of equipment performance.

• Conduct inspections, testing, calibration, and verification of mechanical and control‑related systems.

• Coordinate onsite project activities, schedules, and resources to ensure timely completion.

• Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, and project management teams to resolve technical issues.

• Prepare accurate and professional documentation, including installation records, commissioning reports, and service summaries.

• Maintain compliance with all safety, quality, and regulatory standards.

• Serve as the primary onsite point of contact for customers, providing training, guidance, and technical support.

• Represent FLS with professionalism and integrity in all customer interactions.

**Qualifications

****Required

**

• Strong mechanical background with hands‑on experience in Installation & Commissioning (I&C) of industrial process equipment.

• Experience with thickeners, flotation cells, clarifiers, cyclones, pumps, reactors, or similar industrial equipment.

• Demonstrated ability to work independently and make informed decisions under pressure.

• Strong project management skills, including planning, coordination, and documentation.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce high‑quality technical reports.

• Ability and willingness to travel internationally up to 70% of the time.

• Professional demeanor with the ability to represent the company effectively onsite.

**Preferred

**

• Experience in commissioning or startup of industrial process systems.

• Background in mining, minerals processing, water treatment, or heavy industrial environments.

• Multilingual capabilities or experience working in multicultural settings.

• Ability to meet all medical and physical fitness requirements necessary to obtain work authorization for high‑altitude job sites.

**Competencies

**

• Technical proficiency in mechanical systems and industrial equipment

• Strong problem‑solving and decision‑making abilities

• Customer service orientation

• Professional communication and reporting skills

• Ability to perform effectively in high‑pressure environments

• Self‑motivation and independence in field operations

We offer all employees access to a dedicated recognition platform, empowering you to celebrate achievements, share appreciation and stay connected globally.

**Your impact begins here

**As Safety Surveillance Principal Process Specialist, you will keep Safety Surveillance ready for every audit and inspection, and make sure the way we monitor safety information keeps pace with legislation. You will be a highly visible process expert: leading our contribution to inspections, co-driving regulatory surveillance and shaping how we integrate processes after acquisitions. Your work keeps surveillance of Novo’s marketed and developmental products compliant, simpler and focused on the work that adds most value.

**What You’ll Bring

**You know drug safety from the inside, and you know what it takes to get an organisation ready for an inspection. You will also bring:

• A Master’s degree in Life Sciences, such as Pharmacy, Medicine, Veterinary Science or Biology, or a related field.

• At least 5–7 years of experience in pharmacovigilance, including supporting safety activities in clinical trials.

• Hands-on experience facilitating inspection set-ups, training colleagues and preparing an organisation for audits and inspections.

• Expertise in Safety Surveillance processes and an enterprise mindset: you understand the end-to-end process and can turn complex internal and external requirements into practical ways of working.

• A solid background in handling deviations and implementing process changes.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage and influence senior internal stakeholders and external parties, and a collaborative mindset across functions and geographies.

• Resilience and a calm demeanour in a very busy environment, with the ability to multitask and prioritise your workload through complexity and challenge.

**Desirable, But Not Essential

**Experience in process management and project management.

**What You’ll Do

**You will be a recognised expert in key Safety Surveillance processes, helping the team work with greater simplicity and focus. The role covers a diverse range of tasks, and you could be part of an inspection from day one.

• Lead audits and inspections: coordinate Safety Surveillance contributions, prepare colleagues for interviews, ensure high-quality responses and keep oversight of findings and the associated corrective and preventive actions.

• Act as Process Expert for the signal management process and co-drive the Regulatory Surveillance process, ensuring full compliance with applicable legislation.

• Handle deviations and change requests in close collaboration with colleagues in Safety Surveillance and other relevant functions.

• Support integration and acquisition activities by helping integrate pharmacovigilance processes and systems following company or product acquisitions and mergers.

• Contribute to process improvement projects aligned with our strategic objectives, using your end-to-end view of Safety Surveillance.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the Safety Surveillance Centre of Expertise, a team of five engaged and skilled colleagues within Safety Surveillance, and report to the Director of Safety Surveillance Centre of Expertise.

Safety Surveillance is a department within Global Patient Safety in Research & Development, with departments in Bangalore, India, and Boston, US. Together, we are globally accountable for surveillance of all safety information for Novo’s marketed products and products in development. We also handle safety label updates, Risk Management Plans and aggregate reports.

You will work closely with colleagues across Safety Surveillance and partner with Global Patient Safety, other headquarters functions and affiliates during audits and inspections. When processes need to change, you will bring the right people together, create clarity on what needs to happen and help the team move forward with pace.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will have real visibility as a process expert, and the opportunity to influence how Safety Surveillance works and make a lasting impact. You will be trusted to take ownership, encouraged to make your voice heard, and supported by colleagues who give honest feedback and never compromise on patient safety or quality.

The pace is high and the work is varied. Through process improvement projects and a broad range of tasks, you will build new skills and deepen your understanding of safety surveillance end to end.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 847,000 to

1,245,100 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate's skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here

**Start now

**Your impact begins today, so apply by 17 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We are an equal opportunities employer and are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all applicants.

At Trifork, we're looking for a curious and ambitious Student Product Marketing Assistant to join our Group Marketing team in Copenhagen. You'll play an active role in building market awareness and positioning one of our AI products, working closely with marketing colleagues, product specialists and industry experts.

This is an opportunity to turn ideas into action, take ownership from day one and grow your skills at the intersection of AI, business and marketing.

**What You'll Do

**

• Own the AI product LinkedIn presence: Plan, create and publish engaging social media content to grow awareness, engagement and visibility.

• Create thought leadership: Develop articles, customer stories, LinkedIn posts and other content that positions Trifork as a voice in AI.

**Who You Are

****Why Trifork?

**At Trifork, you'll be surrounded by people passionate about technology and innovation. We believe in giving talent the freedom to explore ideas, take responsibility and make a real difference.

You'll gain hands-on experience in product marketing, work closely with experienced marketing and technology professionals, and develop skills that will accelerate your career.

We offer a collaborative, informal environment, international exposure and flexible working hours that fit around your studies.

Ready to kick-start your career in product marketing and help bring the next generation of AI solutions to market?

**The Role

**You will own and lead global communication strategy for our Urology business area, playing a central role in Ambu’s transformation toward more insight-driven, digitally fluent, and customer-centric marketing. Based at our headquarters in Ballerup, Denmark, you will work closely with other Global MarCom Managers, our Brand & Creation team, Digital Marketing Specialists, Global Product Managers, Medical Affairs, and local sales companies to develop customer-centric, insight-driven, and commercially impactful communication. Your primary team consists of downstream product managers and you will work together on the daily to drive the Urology business forward.

Drive commercial marketing and business impact You will develop and optimize communication throughout the customer journey and your ability to seek out insights, interpret limited data, and translate findings into impactful communication will be essential to our success. From ideation to execution, you’ll ensure alignment, consistency, and commercial impact throughout the customer journey.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Own and lead the development and execution of global communication strategy for Urology, with a strong drive to build data-based customer communication.

• Developing sales enablement materials and content that empower commercial teams and drive engagement with healthcare professionals.

• Collaborating closely with the Digital Marketing team to identify performance and adapt communications accordingly.

• Collaborate with the Brand and Creative team to deliver sales & marketing materials that are both on-brand and commercially effective.

**Commercial mindset, proactive and collaborative

**You are a data-driven, commercially minded marketer, motivated by the challenge of building this capability in a less mature environment. You understand customer journeys and develop communication strategies that optimize business impact, even when insights are limited. You are resourceful, curious, and proactive in seeking out insights, and you can turn even small data points into meaningful communication. You enjoy collaborating with others and are eager to help shape our data-driven future. You’re skilled at managing stakeholders and building alignment across global teams.

To succeed, you’ll need: **Skills

**_Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are however likely to succeed in this position if you have:

_

• A Master’s degree in Marketing, Business, or related field

• 10+ years of experience in commercial marketing, acquired in corporate roles, agencies, or both.

• Proven commercial experience within MedTech or Pharma.

• A proven ability to connect marketing to business results through communication & channel strategy, and sales enablement.

• Driven, hands-on, and strong sense of ownership.

• Strong project leadership skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities across time zones and functions.

• A proactive mindset with the ability to drive transformation in how we engage HCPs and stakeholders

• Excellent communication skills in English (verbal and written)

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is on an ambitious growth journey, expanding globally and pushing the boundaries of innovation in healthcare. Here, your contributions will directly shape our success. You’ll work in an international head office with a collaborative, open culture—where ideas matter, and impact is visible. We offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits along with exciting job challenges and career opportunities contributing to your job satisfaction.

**When to apply

**If you are ready to apply for the position, please apply. Your application will be treated confidentially.

Working at the intersection of engineering, operations, project execution, suppliers, and management, you will play a key role in aligning diverse stakeholder needs and translating them into clear requirements, priorities, and improvement initiatives. Success in this role requires strong stakeholder management capabilities, sound technical judgement, and the ability to balance operational, commercial, and safety considerations.

You will drive the development of the traverse equipment roadmap, monitor fleet performance, and lead continuous improvement efforts throughout the equipment lifecycle. By fostering collaboration, standardization, and the adoption of new technologies, you will help ensure that our traverse solutions continue to support safe and efficient offshore operations worldwide.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Own the traverse equipment lifecycle, ensuring optimal performance, reliability, safety, and long-term business value.

• Translate operational and stakeholder needs into clear requirements, success criteria, and approved improvement initiatives.

• Demonstrated experience in equipment ownership, technical leadership, or lifecycle management of complex engineered products.

• Ability to convert operational challenges and user feedback into technical requirements, validation criteria, and improvement plans.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with a structured, proactive, and solution-oriented approach.

You will join a global team responsible for the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of specialized offshore equipment. jobs.description:
PharmaRelations is the Nordic market leader in talent services for the life science industry. We specialize in partnering with some of the most innovative and successful organizations across the Nordic life science sector. We create value for both clients and candidates through our consultancy services, outsourcing solutions, and recruitment of specialists and leaders.

We are a Nordic organization with over 200 colleagues and with offices in Sweden, Norway, Denmark and Finland. PharmaRelations is headquartered in Solna, Sweden.

PharmaRelations is now looking for a Head of Clinical Operations in Denmark who wants to continue to build and develop our business in Denmark and south of Sweden (Öresundsregionen). The Clinical Development business unit at PharmaRelations focus on ad-hoc support, consultant services as well as outsourcing within clinical trials, to our clients in the Life Science Industry.

You will be responsible for sales as well as working approximately half of your time operationally in clincal trial assignments. You will also be part of the Nordic Leadership Team for Clinical Development. The role reports to the Nordic Head of Clinical Development and can be based in the broader Copenhagen area.

We offer you an inspiring and engaging place to work with great possibility to influence our business as well as to develop professionally moving forward.

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for you with solid experience from working with clinical trials and sponsor oversight in the Life Science Industry. It will be an advantage if you have also experience from a consultancy company. Most importantly, you have a passion for sales and building strong and long-lasting relationships. About the role

You are the senior technical owner of AI enablement at Usercentrics: the person who takes the hardest department AI builds, the deepest platform problems, and the technical bar the rest of the enablement track works to.

At the department layer, you do what every AI Enablement Engineer does, prototyping and shipping AI applications for Finance, Legal, HR, Marketing, Customer Success, BI and beyond, but you take the hardest ones yourself and set the pattern the others follow. About the role

Your responsibilities

As Junior Buyer, you will own a product group and a selected part of our supplier base. This means that you:

• 
Are responsible for your product group’s buying budget, target margins and buying quantities – and for getting the right products delivered on time and to the agreed quality.

• 
Lead the day-to-day dialogue and price negotiations with your suppliers, and follow up on their performance on quality, delivery precision and compliance.

• 
Represent the buying team in collection meetings and contribute data-driven recommendations on assortment, depth and pricing.

• 
Make sure your products meet our requirements for responsible production, certifications and product safety.

Your responsibilities will grow with your experience – for example with additional product groups, new suppliers or cross-functional projects in Supply Chain.

What you will work with

Suppliers & negotiation

• 
Negotiate prices, terms, MOQs and lead times with your suppliers, and prepare each negotiation with clear data and targets.

• 
Follow up on supplier performance – delivery precision, quality and responsiveness – and handle claims and corrective actions.

• 
Help develop our supplier base, including evaluating new suppliers and materials together with the team.

• 
Make sure certificates (e.g. GOTS and GRS), test reports and product safety documentation are in place for your products.

Collection & orders

• 
Take part in collection meetings from line planning to final range, working closely with Design and Sales on assortment and priorities.

• 
Place and manage purchase orders, making sure quantities, prices and master data are correct in our systems.

• 
Follow your orders through production and shipment in close cooperation with Logistics, and react quickly to delays or changes.

• 
Drive the sample flow and seasonal timeline for your product group, and make sure deadlines are met across teams.

About you

You are commercially minded and enjoy combining numbers, products and people. You take ownership of your area, keep track of the details without losing the big picture, and want a real say in what ends up in the collection. We imagine that you:

Have 1–3 years of experience in buying, merchandising, sourcing or product development – ideally within fashion, footwear or lifestyle.

• 
Hold a relevant education, e.g. Design Technology (Fashion Management), a Bachelor in Design & Business, a Bachelor in International Sales & Marketing, or similar.

• 
Are analytical and confident with numbers, Excel, costings and margin calculations. Experience with an ERP or PLM system is a plus.

• 
Have hands-on experience with supplier dialogue and are comfortable leading price negotiations.

• 
Work in a structured way and take responsibility for your results from start to finish.

• 
Communicate clearly and confidently in English, both written and spoken. Danish is a plus, but not a requirement.

• 
Can prioritise between several tasks and deadlines at once, and keep a cool head when plans change.

•

Buying Trainee

Wheat is one of the leading Scandinavian fashion lifestyle brands for children. We are passionate about creating clothing, footwear and accessories that combine timeless design, comfort, and responsible production.

For more than 25 years, we have designed products with great care and attention to detail. Our collections build on a long-standing Danish design tradition, where our most important signatures are high quality and longevity.

We are committed to doing business responsibly — balancing people, planet and profit — and continuously working to reduce our environmental footprint while creating products made to last.

Today, Wheat is powered by an international team of 50+ colleagues with headquarters in our office in Gentofte (Greater Copenhagen), and local offices or showrooms in Munich, Hamburg, Oslo and London.

We believe that diversity of perspectives strengthens creativity, innovation and decision-making — and we strive to build a workplace where everyone feels respected, included and able to contribute.

About the role

Have you recently graduated and are you ready to learn buying and product development from the ground up at an international children’s wear brand? We are looking for an analytical and curious trainee to join our Buying & Supply Chain team on a two-year traineeship. We imagine that you come from a programme at EK – Copenhagen Business Academy – or similar.

Your two-year traineeship

Experience from an internship or student job in buying, fashion or lifestyle is a plus, but not a requirement. We value your motivation, curiosity and willingness to learn.

Increasing responsibility and influence as your skills develop

SENIOR BACKEND DEVELOPER

🚀 We're looking for an ambitious, self-driven Senior Backend Developer to join our engineering team. You'll work primarily with TypeScript and AWS serverless technologies, with occasional work in our React/Next.js frontend. A growing part of our platform is integrating with enterprise customers and external systems, so you'll design and own APIs and integrations that need to hold up under real-world use.

This is a high-impact role with end-to-end ownership, from requirements to a production-ready solution, and a chance to contribute meaningfully to the green transition.

🛠️ What You'll Be Doing

• Taking features from design through implementation and into production

• Building and operating event-driven, distributed systems — async processing, retries, failure handling, idempotency

• Designing APIs and integrations for enterprise and external systems — stable contracts, versioning, auth, error handling, backwards compatibility

• Working in and improving our existing codebase — refactoring, automated testing, managing technical debt

• Occasional frontend work in React/TypeScript

🧠 Your Experience

• 3 to 5+ years of professional software development, with substantial recent experience in TypeScript/Node.js and AWS serverless or event-driven architectures

• Strong hands-on experience with AWS services - Lambda, DynamoDB, queues, event buses, API services, infrastructure as code

• Experience with NoSQL data modelling and production data systems

• Good understanding of authentication, authorization and application security

• Experience operating production systems - debugging, monitoring, safely deploying changes

• Comfortable with Git-based workflows and CI/CD

• Some React/TypeScript experience, and willingness to make occasional frontend changes

✅ What We Expect at Senior Level

You can independently take a feature or technical problem from requirements to a production-ready solution. You're comfortable navigating unfamiliar code, understanding the blast radius of a change, and making pragmatic calls between delivery speed, reliability and maintainability.

You think carefully about system boundaries and integration contracts, understanding that APIs used by customers and external systems need to evolve safely and behave predictably when either side fails. You understand rollback, backwards compatibility, failure modes and safe deployment for systems handling production data.

You communicate trade-offs clearly and take responsibility for the quality of what you ship.

You're comfortable using AI-assisted development tools as part of your day-to-day work, and curious about how they can improve how software is designed, built, tested and maintained - not just for code generation, but for understanding unfamiliar code, planning changes, testing, reviewing, debugging and documentation. At the same time, you apply strong engineering judgement: you treat AI-generated output as a draft to review and validate, and you remain responsible for the correctness and security of what you ship.

🌟 Nice to Have

• Enterprise integrations - SSO/federated identity, webhooks, customer-facing APIs

• AWS CDK or similar IaC tooling

• DynamoDB single-table or composite-key modelling

• IoT, connected devices, telemetry or high-volume event processing

• Multi-tenant SaaS platforms

• Energy tech, EV charging, batteries, solar or energy management

• Data platforms, analytics or data lakes

• ISO 27001 or NIS2 experience

• Next.js

You don't need experience with every technology in our stack. We value strong fundamentals and the ability to learn unfamiliar domains fast.

🌆 What Is It Like to Work at FLEXECHARGE?

• Our office sits in Frederiksberg - bright, comfortable, and a genuinely nice place to spend your workday

• You're covered with pension contributions

• Lunch is on-site, delicious, and genuinely healthy and nutritious

• We like each other's company outside of work too, so think Friday bars, plus company team events and team buildings on a team level

• Opportunities for individual development

🤝 Our Interview Process

Here's roughly what happens once we've had a look at your application:

• A first conversation, about 30 minutes, you'll talk with our recruiter, get a feel for the role, ask whatever's on your mind, and we'll both get a sense of whether this is worth pursuing further

• Time with the team - a conversation with Artur, our Head of Engineering, and Robert, our CTO

• A technical stage - one or more interviews with the team, which may include a case exercise and follow-up discussions. These can take place remotely or at our office.

• A conversation with Max, our CEO, alongside someone else from the team

Hiring carefully matters to us - we want to get to know you properly, and we want you to get a real feel for us too. If there's anything we can do to make the process work better for you, tell us.

We'd love to hear from you. Find a link to apply here 👉 https://thehub.io/jobs/6ab5030dfd5518f38b6960b2?utm_source=client&utm_medium=dashboard&utm_campaign=startupshared

Only candidates currently located in Copenhagen, or those who clearly state in their application that they plan to relocate, will be considered.

• We do not offer visa sponsorship for this role

Do you have experience configuring, testing and commissioning control systems for high-voltage substations? Would you like to apply your expertise to projects supporting Denmark’s electricity transmission grid? Join COWI as a Substation Control and Automation Specialist.

Develop and commission substation control systems

We are looking for an experienced specialist to work on control and automation systems for Energinet’s 132–400 kV substations. Projects range from new substations to extensions, refurbishment and replacement of systems at existing sites.

You will design, configure, test and commission substation control systems, including remote terminal units (RTUs), bay control units (BCUs) and human–machine interfaces (HMIs). Working closely with other specialists, you will ensure that these systems operate correctly and integrate with the substation’s primary equipment, protection systems and communication infrastructure.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Design and configure substation control and monitoring functions in accordance with functional requirements and customer specifications.

• Configure, test and commission RTUs, bay control units and HMIs.

• Configure and verify communication interfaces between control devices, protection equipment and remote control systems.

• Plan and perform functional and integration testing to verify control functions, signal exchange and correct operation of system interfaces.

• Troubleshoot configuration, communication and interface issues in collaboration with other technical specialists.

• Prepare and maintain configuration documentation, test procedures and test records.

• Coordinate technical interfaces with colleagues responsible for protection, communication systems, electrical design and primary equipment

• Undertake the designated on-site role of “holdleder” when required and subject to the relevant qualifications and authorisation.

Your expertise

You take a systematic approach to configuration, testing and troubleshooting. You work independently, pay close attention to technical detail and collaborate effectively with colleagues, customers and suppliers. You understand how individual devices and interfaces contribute to the operation of the complete substation control system.

You will also bring:

• A relevant qualification in electrical engineering or an equivalent technical background, combined with at least five years of relevant experience with control systems for high-voltage substations.

• Demonstrated experience configuring and testing substation control equipment from multiple manufacturers.

• Practical experience with IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 60870-5-103 and IEC 61850 communication protocols and standards.

• A sound understanding of the interfaces between substation control systems, protection equipment and high-voltage primary equipment.

• Experience with functional testing, system integration and commissioning of substation control systems.

• Professional proficiency in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

• The ability to obtain the required security clearance and meet the qualification and authorisation requirements for acting as “holdleder” at high-voltage substations.

Your place of work

Depending on project requirements, you may work from one of COWI’s offices in Denmark, at Energinet project locations or partly from home. Testing and commissioning activities will require attendance at the relevant project sites. Travel within Denmark is expected.

A place to work and so much more

At COW, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Got more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Head of Discipline Carsten Sass Husum at CSHU@COWI.COM.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Student Assistant to join our team. In this role, you will support a wide range of operational and financial activities that are essential to our day-to-day business. You will work closely with colleagues across Finance, Procurement, and external vendors, gaining valuable insight into financial processes and stakeholder management within an international organization.

This is an excellent opportunity for a student who enjoys working with data, optimizing processes, and collaborating with multiple stakeholders while developing practical experience alongside their studies.

As a Student Assistant, you will become part of a collaborative and supportive team where you will gain hands-on experience with financial operations, procurement processes, vendor management, and business analytics. You will have the opportunity to build practical skills, work with experienced professionals, and contribute meaningfully to the team's success while continuing your studies at our HQ office in Valby.

**Key Responsibilities

**As our Student Assistant, your responsibilities will include:

• Review and approval of vendor invoices in accordance with internal procedures

• Communicate with external vendors and the Accounts Payable team regarding invoicing and payment-related matters

• Coordinate with the Procurement team on Purchase Requisition and Purchase Order activities

• Assist in monitoring departmental spend and help maintain department financial overviews and accruals

• Maintain and update financial data to support dashboards, reporting, and data visualization

• Support access management processes, including maintaining access records and tracking user permissions

• Prepare, write, and distribute meeting minutes and follow up on agreed action items

• Assist with a variety of ad hoc administrative, operational, and analytical tasks as needed

**Requirments

**You Are Currently In The Final Year Of Your Bachelor's Degree And Intend To Continue Your Studies At The Master's Level. Relevant Fields Of Study Include

• Business Administration

• Economics

• Business Economics

• Finance

• Accounting

• Or a similar business-related discipline

**Moreover, You Are Someone Who Is

**

• Proactive and eager to take initiative

• Curious by nature and motivated to learn new systems and processes

• Outgoing and comfortable communicating with colleagues across different functions

• Structured, organized, and attentive to detail

• Able to work independently while also enjoying being part of a collaborative team

• Comfortable working with numbers and data and interested in financial and operational processes

• Experience with or strong interest in AI, automation, etc. will be considered an advantage

• Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel; experience with Power BI or similar visualization tools is an advantage but not a requirement

• Fluent in English, both written and spoken

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK180,00---180,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).
